description:
Mark Lawless Auctioneers are delighted to present this three-bedroom detached bungalow, extending to approximately 108 sq. m., set on a generous 0.46-acre site in a peaceful countryside location just outside Edenderry, close to the Kildare/Offaly border.
The property is in good overall condition and offers spacious, well-proportioned accommodation, comprising a living room, kitchen, three bedrooms and bathroom. There is excellent scope for the new owners to modernise and personalise the home to their own taste.
Externally, the property benefits from mature gardens, a tarmac driveway and generous parking, together with a large garage incorporating storage space. A further separate recreational area provides valuable additional space, ideal for a games room, home gym, workshop or family use.
The substantial site offers plenty of room for outdoor enjoyment and further landscaping, subject to planning permission.
Located approximately 3 km from Edenderry, the property is within easy reach of schools, shops, restaurants, sporting facilities and local amenities. The nearby Rahan Woods and River Boyne provide excellent opportunities for walking, cycling and outdoor pursuits, while Edenderry Golf Club and Highfield Golf & Country Club are also close by.
With its generous site, additional outbuildings and convenient location, this property offers an excellent opportunity for first-time buyers, families, downsizers or those seeking a peaceful countryside home within easy reach of town amenities.
Viewing is highly recommended.
